page.title: Cell Scanner
page.description: Sweep every supported band for the towers in range. Best results with the SIM removed.

run.title: Full network sweep
run.description: One pass across every band this modem supports.
run.summary_empty: The sweep finished without listing a single cell, so there is nothing to break down.
run.verdict_all_good_one: The one cell that reported a level came back good. A sweep measures without the serving cell's help, so a reading at this level is a genuinely strong candidate.
run.verdict_all_good_other: All {{count}} cells that reported a level came back good. A sweep measures without the serving cell's help, so readings at this level are genuinely strong candidates.
run.verdict_all_fair_one: The one cell that reported a level sits at fair. A sweep measures without the serving cell's help, and an indoor pass usually reads 10 to 15 dB below what the dashboard shows.
run.verdict_all_fair_other: All {{count}} cells that reported a level sit at fair. A sweep measures without the serving cell's help, and an indoor pass usually reads 10 to 15 dB below what the dashboard shows.
run.verdict_all_poor_one: The one cell that reported a level came back weak. A sweep measures without the serving cell's help, and an indoor pass usually reads 10 to 15 dB below what the dashboard shows — so this is not the same judgement as your own connection being weak.
run.verdict_all_poor_other: All {{count}} cells that reported a level came back weak, so the whole table sits at the bottom of the ramp. A sweep measures without the serving cell's help, and an indoor pass usually reads 10 to 15 dB below what the dashboard shows — so this is not the same judgement as your own connection being weak.
run.verdict_no_readings: The modem listed these cells but reported no signal level for any of them, so none of them can be rated.
run.idle_body: Nothing has been scanned since this page loaded. A sweep lists every tower in range, on every band.
run.scanning_body: Keep this tab open — the results land here when the modem finishes.
run.failed_body: The modem may be busy or unreachable. Check the connection and run the sweep again.

suggestions.rationale_bands: The band lock keeps the modem on the carrier's main 5G bands, which usually improves stability. It can also reduce coverage where only other bands reach you. Bands the modem does not report as supported are left out, and deactivating the profile removes the lock.
suggestions.rationale_ttl: TTL and hop limit are set to 64 so traffic from devices behind the modem leaves with the same value as traffic from the modem itself. Deactivating the profile restores the previous values.

live.add_hint: Add copies the channel into the list below. A frequency lock takes no PCI, so the modem still chooses the cell.
live.compare_hint: A tower lock already pins a channel and a cell. A frequency lock is the looser option: same channel, any cell.
live.compare_hint_unknown: The tower lock state could not be read. A frequency lock is refused while a tower lock is active, so nothing here can be applied until that read succeeds.
live.add_blocked: Adding is disabled until the tower lock is released.
live.add_blocked_unknown: Adding is disabled until the tower lock state can be read.

verdict.unlocked_body: The modem may use any channel its enabled bands offer, and reselects freely. Allow a channel to narrow that down.
verdict.locked_body: The modem may use only the channels below. It still chooses the cell, so the PCI can change.
verdict.blocked_title: Tower lock is holding the radio
verdict.blocked_body: QManager will not write a frequency lock while a tower lock is active. Release the tower lock to use this page.
verdict.blocked_unknown_body: QManager could not read whether a tower lock is active. Frequency lock changes stay blocked until that read succeeds, because applying one over a live tower lock can crash the modem. Refresh to try again.
verdict.unknown_body: The modem did not answer the last status read. Refresh to try again.
verdict.serving_in_list: Serving channel is in the list
verdict.serving_out_of_list: Serving channel is outside the list
verdict.tower_lock_off: Tower lock off, so this is available

lte.title: LTE channels
lte.description: Up to 2 EARFCNs. The modem may use only these.

nr.title: 5G NR channels
nr.description: Up to 32 ARFCNs, each with its subcarrier spacing.

card.empty_body_lte: Add a carrier from above, or type an EARFCN.
card.empty_body_nr: Add the NR carrier above, or enter an ARFCN and pick its spacing.
card.blocked_body: Release the tower lock to edit this list.
card.scs_warning: A wrong spacing looks like a valid entry, but the modem never uses it. The value is copied from the carrier when you add it from above.
card.no_pci_note: A frequency lock never pins the cell. The modem keeps reselecting inside the channels you allow.

blocked.tower_lock_active: A tower lock is holding this radio. Release it before locking a frequency.
blocked.tower_lock_unknown: The tower lock state could not be read, so this lock is refused until the modem answers. Refresh to try again.

slots.optional: Optional. A second channel widens the allow list.
slots.staged_count: {{count}} of {{max}} entries staged. Nothing is on the modem yet.

actions.use_current_hint: Fill from the channels the modem is using now

apply.disclaimer: Applying drops the connection briefly while the radio re-registers. A channel with no coverage leaves the modem without service until you clear the lock.
apply.no_recovery: Frequency locking has no failover watcher. Unlike band and tower locking, nothing restores service on its own if these channels lose coverage.
apply.readback_none: No frequency lock on the modem
apply.blocked_title: Apply is unavailable while a tower lock is active
apply.blocked_readback: Tower lock active · frequency lock unavailable
apply.blocked_unknown_title: Apply is unavailable until the tower lock state can be read
apply.blocked_unknown_readback: Tower lock state unknown, so writing is blocked
apply.applying_title: Waiting for the modem to come back
apply.clobbered_body: The modem no longer reports the lock this page applied. Setting a tower lock replaces a frequency lock without warning, so that is the likely cause.

progress.title: Writing channels
progress.wait_note: This takes a few seconds. Do not reboot.
progress.carriers_return: Carriers reappear once the modem registers on an allowed channel.
progress.stuck_warning: If nothing returns within a minute, the chosen channels have no coverage here. Clearing the lock restores normal scanning.
progress.paused: Editing is paused until the modem answers.

dialog.lock_lte_body: The modem will use only {{channels}} and may briefly disconnect while it re-registers.
dialog.lock_nr_body: The modem will use only {{channels}} and may briefly disconnect while it re-registers.
dialog.unlock_lte_body: The modem will be free to use any channel its enabled bands offer, and may briefly disconnect.
dialog.unlock_nr_body: The modem will be free to use any channel its enabled bands offer, and may briefly disconnect.
dialog.unsupported_title: These channels are outside your modem's bands
dialog.unsupported_body: Locking to a band the modem does not support can make it restart unexpectedly, and nothing here will recover it automatically.

toast.lte_lock_failed: Could not apply the LTE frequency lock
toast.lte_clear_failed: Could not clear the LTE frequency lock
toast.nr_lock_failed: Could not apply the 5G NR frequency lock
toast.nr_clear_failed: Could not clear the 5G NR frequency lock
toast.filled_from_current: Filled from the carriers on air
toast.no_channels_body: Enter at least one channel before applying.

error.load_title: Could not read the lock state
error.load_body: The modem did not answer. Refresh to try again.
error.tower_lock_active: A tower lock is active, so the modem will not accept a frequency lock.
error.invalid_channel: Channel numbers must be digits only.

a11y.add_carrier: Add this carrier to the list

errors.tower_state_unknown: The modem did not report whether a tower lock is active, so the frequency lock was not written. Refresh and try again.

summary.rest_of_day: in force for the rest of today

page.title: Cellular and Radio Information
page.description: Everything the modem currently reports about its radio link: identity, spectrum in use, and per-carrier signal quality.

alert.modem_unreachable: Can't reach the modem — showing the last values received.

header.copy_error: Couldn't copy to the clipboard. Select the values manually instead.

network.label: Network type
network.caption_unknown: The modem did not report an access technology

no_sim.title: No SIM detected
no_sim.description: The modem cannot see a SIM card, so there is no radio link to report. Check that the SIM is seated in the active slot.

no_service.title: No service
no_service.description: The SIM is present but the modem is not registered on any network. Signal metrics stay empty until it attaches.

searching.title: Searching for a network
searching.description: The modem is scanning for a usable cell. Radio details appear as soon as it registers.

unknown.title: Radio state not reported
unknown.description: The modem returned a status this page does not recognise. Try refreshing; if it persists, the poller may need a restart.

cellular_card.title: Connection details
cellular_card.description: Reported by the network on the current attach.

value.distance_hint: Calculated from the network's timing-advance value, which the radio reports in coarse steps. Read it as a rough range to the serving cell, not a measured distance.

bands.title: Spectrum in use
bands.description_one: {{count}} active carrier, with its live signal metrics below.
bands.description_other: {{count}} active carriers, with live signal metrics for each one.
bands.released_note: This carrier stopped being reported {{seconds}}s ago. It stays listed for a short while in case it comes back.

detail.scs_derived_hint: The modem reports subcarrier spacing only for the serving NR cell. This value is derived from the band's duplex mode, not read from the radio.

bands.low_snr: SNR on this carrier is {{value}} dB, which is in the poor range.

empty.title: No carriers reported
empty.description: The modem is not reporting any aggregated carriers right now. That is normal while the radio is searching, idle, or between handovers.

scanner.body: Looking for carriers the modem is not using? The cell scanner sweeps every band the radio supports.

card.title: Connection scenarios
card.description: Radio configuration. Profiles bind these; the active one owns band locking.

scenarios.ownership_notice: While a scheduled profile is active, scenario activation is owned by its schedule. Manual band locking stays disabled until you deactivate the profile.

error.title: Couldn't load scenarios
error.body: Showing the last known list. Try again in a moment.

toast.create_success_from_profile: Scenario created. Return to your profile and select it.

active_config.title: {{name}} Configuration
active_config.disabled_tooltip: Scenario activation is managed by the {{profile}} Custom SIM Profile.

delete_dialog.title: Delete Scenario
delete_dialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

page.title: SMS Center
page.description: View, manage, and send SMS messages from your modem.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: View and manage your SMS messages

empty_state.title: No messages
empty_state.description: Your inbox is empty. Send a new message to get started.

error.title: Failed to load messages
error.body_stale: Another AT consumer is probably holding the modem lock; it usually clears within a cycle. The messages below are the last successful read and are no longer live.
error.body_empty: Nothing has been read from the modem yet.

view_dialog.title: Message from {{sender}}
view_dialog.copy_error: Couldn't copy — the browser blocked clipboard access on this connection.
view_dialog.no_reply_hint: This sender is an alphanumeric ID rather than a number, so it cannot be replied to.

delete_single_confirm.title: Delete Message
delete_single_confirm.description: Are you sure you want to delete this message from {{sender}}? This action cannot be undone.

delete_all_confirm.title: Delete all {{count}} messages?
delete_all_confirm.description: This removes {{me}} from the modem memory and {{sm}} from the SIM. Deleted messages cannot be recovered, and the modem is not rebooted.
delete_all_confirm.progress_note: One delete per memory, serialized behind the shared AT lock.

delete_selected_confirm.title: Delete Selected Messages
delete_selected_confirm.description_one: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected message? This action cannot be undone.
delete_selected_confirm.description_other: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected messages? This action cannot be undone.

inbox.description_split: Messages read from both memories. {{me}}/{{meTotal}} in modem memory, {{sm}}/{{smTotal}} on the SIM.
inbox.description_combined: Messages read from both memories. {{used}} slots used across both.
inbox.description_unknown: Slot usage is unknown until the next successful read.

compose.title: New Message
compose.description: Compose and send an SMS message.
compose.limit_warning: Message exceeds single SMS limit. It will be sent as multiple parts.
compose.sending_note: Waiting on the AT lock, then sending
compose.encoding_hint: A non-ASCII character switches the message to UCS-2 and caps a single part at 70 characters.

page.title: SMS Forwarding
page.description: Relay every incoming message to another number, and watch whether the relay is actually getting through.

relay.title: Forwarding Relay
relay.description: Turn the relay on and choose where messages go.

health.title: Delivery Health
health.description: Live relay state, a recipient preview, and any failed sends.

fields.target_hint: Include the country code. Every message that arrives on this modem is relayed to this number.
fields.target_invalid: Enter a valid phone number, including the country code — for example +15551234567.

unconfigured.label: No destination set
unconfigured.description: Forwarding is on, but there is nowhere to send to yet. Add a number to start relaying.

off.label: Forwarding off
off.description: Incoming messages stay in the modem inbox and are not relayed anywhere.

preview.note: The number in the From line is an example of an incoming sender. Your saved number is the one receiving this message, not sending it.

test.hint_ready: Sends a test message to the saved number, so it checks the relay path that is actually running.
test.hint_blocked: Turn forwarding on and save a destination number first — the test always runs against saved settings, never against unsaved edits.

failures.description: The relay retried each of these three times and then gave up, so the message stayed in the inbox. Forwarding is still running.

failures.title: No delivery failures
failures.description: Every message the relay has picked up so far reached its destination.

error.title: Couldn't load forwarding settings
error.description: The modem didn't answer, so the current relay settings are unknown.

toast.test_success: Test message sent to the saved number
toast.test_error: Failed to send the test message

page.title: Tower Locking
page.description: Pin the modem to a specific physical cell by PCI and channel.

live.title: Right now
live.camped_empty_body: The modem is not camped on any cell right now. A lock still applies once it attaches.
live.note_hint: Add copies this cell into the form below. A tower lock pins the channel and its PCI together, so the modem holds this exact cell.
live.tile_use_a11y: Use band {{band}}, PCI {{pci}} as the {{leg}} lock target
live.tile_locked_a11y: Band {{band}}, PCI {{pci}} is the current lock target
live.tile_blocked_slots_full: All three LTE cells are set
live.refresh: Re-read lock state from the modem
live.persist_help: Stores the lock on the modem itself, so it is restored automatically after a restart.
live.persist_split_help: The modem reports this saved for one radio but not the other. Switch it off and on again to rewrite both.
live.persist_toast_enabled: Lock will be kept after reboot
live.persist_toast_disabled: Lock will not be kept after reboot
live.failover_help: Releases the tower lock automatically if signal quality stays below the threshold, so a bad cell cannot strand the connection. It releases both radios, not just the weak one.
live.threshold_unread: Not read from the modem yet.
live.verdict_on_target_body: The radio is camped on a cell you locked.
live.verdict_off_target_body: The lock is set, but the radio is somewhere else.
live.verdict_unverified_body: A lock is set, but nothing is on air to compare it against.
live.verdict_unlocked_body: The modem picks its own cell and reselects freely.
live.verdict_unknown_body: The lock state has not been read back from the modem.

automation.title: While nobody is watching
automation.description: What the lock does across a reboot, in bad signal, and on a timer.

lte.title: LTE Tower
lte.description: Pin the 4G radio to as many as three cells, by channel and PCI.

nr_sa.title: 5G NR-SA Tower
nr_sa.description: Pin the 5G standalone radio to a single cell.

fields.scs_guess: Filled from the band {{band}} default. Verify it against your tower if the lock fails.
fields.scs_from_serving: Read from the cell the modem is camped on.

card.gate_nsa_body: Standalone locking needs the modem in SA mode. It is currently using 5G anchored to an LTE cell.
card.gate_lte_body: The modem is on LTE only, so there is no NR cell to pin.
card.empty_body: Pick a cell from the list above, or type a channel and PCI.

schedule.title: Lock schedule
schedule.description: Apply the tower lock only inside a daily window.
schedule.toast_no_targets: Set a lock target before scheduling
schedule.arm_warning: Saved, but the schedule isn't armed: {{reason}}
schedule.arm_reason_unit_absent: the scheduling service isn't installed on this device yet — update to the latest firmware to enable it

dialog.lock_lte_body_one: The modem drops its connection briefly and reattaches to {{summary}}. If that cell is unreachable you may lose service until the lock is removed.
dialog.lock_lte_body_other: The modem drops its connection briefly and reattaches to one of {{count}} cells. If none are reachable you may lose service until the lock is removed.
dialog.lock_nr_body: The modem drops its connection briefly and reattaches to {{summary}}. If that cell is unreachable you may lose service until the lock is removed.
dialog.unlock_body: The radio goes back to choosing its own cell. The connection drops briefly while it reattaches.

toast.incomplete: Fill in every field before locking
toast.no_targets: Enter a channel and cell ID first
toast.slots_full: All three LTE cells are already set

warning.service_enable_failed: The lock is active now, but it will not survive a reboot — the modem rejected the save command.
warning.service_disable_failed: The lock is released, but it could not be removed from startup — it may come back after a reboot.
warning.persist_command_failed: "Keep lock after reboot" did not take. The modem rejected the save command.

error.title: Couldn't read tower lock state
error.body: The modem did not answer after three attempts. Nothing below reflects the radio's real lock state until this succeeds.
error.retry_tip: Ask the modem for its lock state again.

blocked.lock_empty_lte: Enter a channel and PCI, or pick a cell from the tiles above.
blocked.lock_incomplete_lte: Every slot you have started needs both a channel and a PCI.
blocked.lock_empty_nr: Enter a channel, PCI, spacing and band, or pick a cell from the tiles above.
blocked.lock_incomplete_nr: All four fields are needed before this cell can be locked.
blocked.lock_unchanged: The radio is already locked to exactly these targets, so there is nothing left to write.
blocked.lock_gated_nsa: The modem is on 5G NSA, where the 5G leg has no standalone cell to lock.
blocked.lock_gated_lte_only: The modem has no 5G carrier on air, so there is nothing to lock it to.
blocked.refresh_in_flight: Already re-reading the modem. This can take a few seconds.
